content.text: For phase 1 implementation, we will only be implementing admin to user delegation. If there is demonstrated need for user to user delegation, we can look at implementing it at a later date.
Here is a PR against your local work:
These updates were motivated by the fact that your implementation seemed to hijack the HttpHeaderPrincipalProvider and use it in a way that was not in line with PrincipalProviders set.
Please, create an integration test in fcrepo-module-auth-webac that demonstrates the use of the HeaderDelegate.
Note, due to the unrelated issue mentioned in email, I have not been able to fully test your PR or mine.
PR for integration tests in the WebAC module:
Implement header-based delegated authentication. Use headers to define the effective agent, independent of any container-based AuthN.
Define a delegated user header (header name TBD)
Restrict delegation such that a user can only delegate to an effective agaent with equal or lower permissions
